summary_en: This Phase II study compares tepotinib with or without ramucirumab in adults with stage IV or recurrent non-small cell lung cancer that has a MET exon 14 skipping gene change. Tepotinib is taken by mouth once a day on days 1 to 21 of each 21-day cycle, and ramucirumab is given into a vein over 30 to 60 minutes on day 1 of each cycle. Cycles repeat every 21 days if the disease does not progress and side effects are not unacceptable, and the main outcome is not stated in the record.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase II compara tepotinib con o sin ramucirumab en adultos con cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas en estadio IV o recurrente, que tiene un cambio en el gen MET llamado salto del exón 14. El tepotinib se toma por vía oral una vez al día en los días 1 a 21 de cada ciclo de 21 días, y el ramucirumab se administra por vena durante 30 a 60 minutos el día 1 de cada ciclo. Los ciclos se repiten cada 21 días si la enfermedad no progresa y los efectos secundarios no son inaceptables, y el resultado principal no se indica en el registro.
who_for: Stage IV or recurrent non-small cell lung cancer with a MET exon 14 skipping mutation
Measurable disease seen on CT or MRI scan
Brain scan within 42 days before randomization
Blood counts, liver and kidney tests within set limits
not_for: Other actionable changes such as EGFR, ALK, ROS1, KRAS, HER2 or BRAF V600E
Prior MET inhibitor or angiogenesis inhibitor therapy, including bevacizumab or ramucirumab
Untreated or active brain metastases or leptomeningeal disease
Interstitial lung disease that needed steroid treatment
